overlap_register.note: Keep NGO applicability and evidence as a scoped variant, not a second generic registration.
Programme/facility licensing is an umbrella for NGO schools, clinics and other activities; source rows retained, but do not duplicate obligations.
Tax registration and subsequent returns/remittances are related but distinct. Refine recurring entries after authoritative research.
Employer registrations, employee account arrangements and recurring statutory returns must not be merged indiscriminately.
Link to each actual licence and verified renewal rule; not one universally applicable deadline.

location_selection: All 36 states plus FCT; selection never establishes coverage.

conflicts_and_assumptions.resolution: 5 map directly to the baseline; 1 is a composite manual/bundle; 21 distinct new candidate documents. Preserve all 27 source IDs.

conflicts_and_assumptions.issue: 80-template R2 target exceeds identified distinct inventory
conflicts_and_assumptions.resolution: 40 baseline + 21 new candidates = 61 distinct planned templates under the composite-manual treatment; select 19 further useful, distinct templates from measured demand. Do not invent completion or duplicate names.

conflicts_and_assumptions.issue: 79 regulatory rows contain overlaps and umbrella topics
conflicts_and_assumptions.resolution: Counts match 9+6+5+12+4+28+5+10=79. REG-G01 aliases REG-D01 for SCUML NGO context. REG-G04 aggregates activity licences already represented by sector topics. Preserve source rows; do not equate row count with distinct obligations or certificates.

conflicts_and_assumptions.issue: Essential Business Documents requests Nigerian-law review before implementation
conflicts_and_assumptions.resolution: Master prompt and TRD supersede blanket professional-review interpretation: separate AI checks plus deterministic gates; future specialist review optional. No publication without adequate evidence.

conflicts_and_assumptions.issue: Essential inventory contains unsupported reference snippets and 2026 assertions
conflicts_and_assumptions.resolution: Treat phrases such as Tax ID +3 and source-name +N fragments as unusable citations. Do not assert NRS, Tax ID, e-invoicing or SCUML applicability from this inventory alone.

Thirty R1 and thirty additional R2 research candidates below are an explicit reversible prioritisation assumption; all remain held and do not count as published. Remaining high-impact/sector entries remain in backlog.
12 exact R1 workflows retained. Twelve additional R2 guided choices remain to be selected and tested; do not claim 24 are implemented.

conflicts_and_assumptions.issue: Restrictive covenants, employee guarantees and NGO governance are high impact
conflicts_and_assumptions.resolution: Keep candidate templates held until policy scope, authoritative evidence, party/use assumptions, rights, enhanced EDP checks and working export tests pass. No enforceability or blanket NGO exemption claim.
